Widcombe & Lyncombe — Bath, United Kingdom

🟢 Official crime data · Avon and Somerset Constabulary, data.police.uk Methodology →

Higher caution advised day Relatively safer night

In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 179 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 7.7 per 1,000 residents, the 13th highest rate of Bath's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (26), vehicle crime (4), burglary (1); the evening/night score by anti social behaviour (11), violent crime (7), public order (2). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Widcombe & Lyncombe safe?

Wandroz currently rates Widcombe & Lyncombe in Bath as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Bath during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Widcombe & Lyncombe safe at night?

At night, Widcombe & Lyncombe is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Widcombe & Lyncombe a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Widcombe & Lyncombe's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Bath) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
